cohort: The study included 3,896,242 singleton live births, with 32,762 conceived via ART, and also analysed 6,458 sibling pairs where one was ART-conceived and the other naturally conceived.
finding: Assisted reproductive technology (ART) was associated with an increased likelihood of low birth weight and preterm birth, even after controlling for underlying maternal factors using discordant-sibling comparison.
cross-section timing: Perinatal (at or around the time of birth)
birth_weight: All singleton live births, with birth weight and low birth weight as key outcomes.
gest_age: All singleton live births, with gestational age and preterm delivery as key outcomes.
